# MediaPipe assets

This directory contains the MediaPipe Tasks Vision 1.1.0 browser runtime and its WASM files from the `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` npm package. The package declares the Apache 2.0 license; its text is in [LICENSE](LICENSE).

The Face Landmarker and Selfie Segmenter model files come from Google's MediaPipe model storage. They run locally in the browser. See the [MediaPipe Face Landmarker guide](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/face_landmarker/web_js) and [Image Segmenter guide](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/image_segmenter/web_js) for model documentation. The model files retain their own source terms.
